source_title: AIGC绘本创作 ｜《羌族神话燃比娃的故事》中式美学诉说民族神话

content_storage_policy.reason: External web article is used as public reference only; do not ingest copyrighted article images or full story text into local training assets without explicit rights.

learning_summary: Use a mythic quest engine: community problem, elder mission, guide animal, ritual object, escalating trials, sacred mountain, gift retrieval and warm return.
Build a compact symbol taxonomy: protagonist, red bird, white stone, sacred mountain, fire seed, obstacles and community.
Use warm-cold contrast to make transformation visible across picturebook pages and animation frames.
For Culture China and university competition boards, present source research, myth structure, storyboard and continuity QA as evidence.
Avoid generic fantasy styling; every costume, object and landscape cue must have cultural or narrative function.
cross_domain_use: Use this batch for ethnic myth AIGC picturebooks, child-hero journey animation prompts, cultural storytelling boards, symbol taxonomy diagrams and Culture China competition process displays.
exclusion_rule: Do not copy original article images, long story text, dialogue, watermarks, source page layout, or unverified cultural claims.
